Canopy Wilderness Camp - Canopy Tented Camps
Welcome to
Canopy Wilderness Camp
—   Your Gateway to Serengeti s Untouched Wonders
Nestled in the heart of the eastern Serengeti, The Canopy Wilderness Camp draws its name from its prime location in one of the untouched corners of this expansive wilderness. Strategically positioned, it offers easy access to game viewing in the serene, less crowded areas of the Eastern Serengeti. As night falls, the camp comes alive with the enchanting melodies of resident lions and leopards, creating a captivating atmosphere. In the morning, the vibrant world of birds adds to the symphony, providing an idyllic setting for both wildlife enthusiasts and photographers alike.

Authentic Experiences
Melissa J
Home away from home,
I stayed at both Canopy Migration camp in Northern Serengeti and Canopy Wilderness camp in eastern Serengeti and both were amazing. The layout of both camps are set so you have an amazing view of the African bush from anywhere in camp. The staff at both camps make you feel like family as they are so welcoming and friendly. They really work hard to make sure you are comfortable and well taken care of. The food was amazing, both played meals and buffet style. And their box lunches are the best I have had anywhere. The tents are well furnished and very comfortable. I loved hearing all the different sounds at night and being able to see wildlife right from my tent. If you are wanting a true safari experience in the African bush, yet still have the comforts of home, then you should check out Canopy Camps for sure.
Stan V
Glamping serengeti.
Stayed here for 2 nights during our safari trip in Serengeti. What a fantastic place. Quiet, good food, and great service. A really good quiet “glamping” accomodation in the middle of the national park. Even the beds were super comfortable, and you might hear some hyena’s howl during the night!
Amir
Amazing Camp with good staff and good food,
Never had an camping experience before but this was the best one we ever had Friendly staff and very good food unlike other 5 star hotels Location was good and rooms were very clean and had attached bathroom and toilet facility no mosquitoes or flies Overall had good experience
